title: Legendary Investor Dan Loeb on AI, Credit, & Third Point’s $25B Strategy
summary: Additionally, he reveals the painful lessons learned from the FTX collapse, the genius of the Danaher business system, and how his firm uses reinsurance to drive growth. Dan shares his incredible evolution from a deep-value, event-driven credit investor to a dynamic capital allocator spanning equities, venture capital, and private credit. They dive into the current macro environment, focusing heavily on the transformative power of AI, semiconductors, and energy.

reader_summary.overview: Patrick O'Shaughnessy sits down with Dan Loeb, the legendary investor and founder of Third Point. Dan shares his incredible evolution from a deep-value, event-driven credit investor to a dynamic capital allocator spanning equities, venture capital, and private credit. They dive into the current macro environment, focusing heavily on the transformative power of AI, semiconductors, and energy.

key_points.text: Dan also unpacks his most memorable activist campaigns, including Sotheby's and Sony, and explains what makes a truly great corporate governance structure.
Additionally, he reveals the painful lessons learned from the FTX collapse, the genius of the Danaher business system.
This is a masterclass in market adaptation, continuous improvement, and the enduring value of human connection in finance.
